Private Sub Edit(ByVal which As Long, c As Object, ByVal t As String, ByVal p As String, r As Variant)
    Select Case which
    Case 1: c.SaveChartTemplate t & ".2.crtx": r = (Dir(t & ".2.crtx") <> ""): Kill t & ".2.crtx"
    Case 2: c.ApplyChartTemplate t: r = c.ChartType
    Case 3: c.ApplyChartTemplate t & ".none.crtx": r = c.ChartType
    Case 4: c.SetBackgroundPicture p: r = c.ChartArea.Format.Fill.Type
    Case 5: c.SetBackgroundPicture p & ".none.png": r = c.ChartArea.Format.Fill.Type
    Case 6: c.Parent.Parent.Range("A4:C4").Copy: c.Paste: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 7: c.Parent.Parent.Range("A4:C5").Copy: c.Paste: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 8: c.Parent.Parent.ChartObjects(2).Chart.ChartArea.Copy: c.Paste xlFormats: r = c.ChartType
    Case 9: Application.CutCopyMode = False: c.Paste: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    End Select
End Sub

Private Function Book() As Workbook
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "One"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
    ws.Range("A4:C4").Value = Array("c", 30, 8)
    ws.Range("A5:C5").Value = Array("d", 40, 9)
    ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
    With ws.Shapes.AddChart2(227, xlLine, 320, 96, 240, 144).Chart
        .SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
    End With
    Set Book = wb
End Function

Public Function MakeTemplate(ByVal t As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Book()
    wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(2).Chart.SaveChartTemplate t
    wb.Close False
    MakeTemplate = CStr(Dir(t) <> "")
End Function

Public Function Act(ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long, ByVal t As String, ByVal p As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, r As Variant, s As String
    Set wb = Book()
    On Error Resume Next
    Edit which, wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart, t, p, r
    s = Err.Number & " " & TypeName(r) & " " & r
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Act = s
End Function
